answer: A jetty only helps ships that actually reach it, so rewards should follow proof of useful work. Each identity posts a refundable deposit and earns weight by completing verified tasks; reaching the summit of influence requires many audited jobs, so jade-like trust cannot be bought instantly. A sybil farm must fund every deposit and do real work per identity, so cost scales linearly. Limit: rich attackers can still pay, and new honest users start with little weight.
